description: ROOF-MEMBER-RENUMBER: b3-hip-v1.3-hole-common's roof lengthened by one spacing to 168 in, the same hole through the front ridge-end common (common/front/ridge/start, X 59.25..60.75), which stays put (the right half moves 24 in +X, a pair of commons and 24 in of ridge are added). The Boolean names the same 1.3.0 id as before the edit. model.json is the plugin's expansion plus the hole (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_roof_member_names.py pins it).
derivation: Every expectation except the mesh counts is ANALYTIC, derived in services/geometry/tests/test_roof_member_renumber.py (derived(), its docstring gives the closed forms) from the BASE golden's hand-derived expected.json and closed forms, never from the kernel; that test asserts this file equals the derivation.

base = b3-hip-6-12 (1.1.0). 1.3.0 is 1.2.0 renamed; on B3 1.2.0 differs from 1.1.0 only by ROOF-HIP-TAIL: each of the four hips loses a sheared prism under its tail, vertical thickness d = P_hip - (P_common - drop), plan 1.5 x 12 sqrt 2, so d x 1.5 x 12 sqrt 2 in^3 (45.967 at 6/12, 44.765 at 8/12), area d sqrt 2 (2 x 12 + 2 x 1.5), centroid over s = 0.375 - 6 sqrt 2 on the hip at the top line less (P_hip + P_common - drop) / 2; the four are mirror images, so X and Y stay. The lowest point becomes the commons' tail bottom, 97.125 - (12 + seat) x rise/12.

168 only: + 2 commons (the side profile's shoelace area x 1.5, its polygon centroid) + 24 in of the 1.5 x 7.25 ridge (its top at the commons' top at its face); centroid X 84 by symmetry; box max X + 24 in; topology + 2 seven-sided prisms (18 faces, 42 edges, 2 shells).

hole: bore = pi r^2 L, r = 0.5, L = 1.5 in (0.375 pi in^3); area + pi (2 r L - 2 r^2) = pi in^2; centre (hole X, 20, 110) in; mass less 450 kg/m^3 x the bore (SPF); topology + 1 face (the bore) + 3 edges (two circles and the seam).
MESH counts are the kernel's, recorded: the bore is tessellated at linear_deflection 0.1.
tolerance_rationale: b3-hip-6-12's bound, unchanged. Measured 2026-10-18 against the derivation: <= 1.2e-7 mm^3 on the volume, <= 4.9e-8 mm^2 on the area, <= 2.3e-12 mm on the centroid and centre of mass, <= 5.9e-11 g on the mass. 1e-6 is 8x the worst; the bore is 7 238 mm^3, so a hole in the wrong body or missing fails by orders of magnitude.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: b3-hip-6-12's reviewed bound (OCCT's STEP rounds the sloped members' coordinates; a build123d twin drifts the same), unchanged; the bore adds no sloped face.
